# Tooltip

Matte-black tooltip (surface-inverse), 12px text, an optional mono shortcut.

`PhantomPortals.Tooltip` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Tooltip content={…}>…</PhantomPortals.Tooltip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.Tooltip" content="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Shows on hover and focus, hides on Escape; links itself to the trigger with aria-describedby.

## Props (TooltipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `shortcut` | `string` |  |
| `children` * | `React.ReactElement` |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` |  |
